ticker_news.title: Meet the Unstoppable Semiconductor Stock Crushing Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom Right Now
ticker_news.description: Corning has emerged as a key player in AI infrastructure by providing advanced fiber optic cables for data centers, driving its stock up 75% in 2025 and outperforming major semiconductor companies.
ticker_news.author: Anthony Di Pizio

ticker_news.title: AMD and OpenAI Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy 6 Gigawatts of AMD GPUs
ticker_news.description: AMD and OpenAI signed a multi-year agreement for 6 gigawatts of GPU deployment, with the first 1 gigawatt of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs starting in the second half of 2026. The partnership includes strategic alignment and AMD issuing OpenAI a warrant for up to 160 million shares.
ticker_news.author: Amd Communications
